soundUnavailable: Sound is unavailable in this browser.
transportAv1Failure: AV1 streaming stopped. Retry or choose another video mode.
transportH264Failure: H.264 streaming stopped. Retry or choose another video mode.
transportH264Unsupported: This browser cannot play this H.264 stream.
videoReasonDecoder: The browser reported a video decoding or media error.
videoReasonSource: The browser closed the video source.
videoReasonPlaybackBlocked: The browser could not start video playback.
videoReasonBuffer: The browser could not append or remove video data.
videoReasonQueue: The browser video queue exceeded its limit.
videoReasonPlaybackTimeout: Video playback stalled for more than 2 seconds.
videoReasonAppendTimeout: Appending video data made no progress for more than 2 seconds.
videoReasonStart: The browser could not initialize the video player.
videoReasonStartTimeout: No playable video frame arrived within 7 seconds.
videoReasonEncoderUnavailable: The host does not have the requested video encoder available.
videoReasonEncoder: Video encoding or packaging failed on the host.
videoReasonFeedbackTimeout: The host received no advancing frame acknowledgement for 3 seconds.
touchHint: Pinch to zoom; slide one finger to pan when zoomed in. Tap to click, or hold then slide to drag remote controls.
touchpadHint: Slide one finger to move the cursor, tap to left-click. Tap with two fingers to right-click, slide in parallel to scroll, and pinch to zoom. Hold one finger, then slide to drag.
resolutionHint: Sets the pixel limit. Automatic matches your display’s pixel density.
pairFailed: Could not complete the authorization. Try again.
accessDenied: The pairing code is incorrect or has changed.
pairLocked: Too many attempts. Ask the host to refresh the pairing code.
editorAlreadyConnected: Another editor is connected. Try again after they disconnect.
loginHint: Sign in with the account provided by the host. Your workspace is kept when you disconnect.
loginFailed: The username or password is incorrect, or the account is disabled.
loginExpired: Your login has expired. Sign in again.
loginLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait one minute and try again.
signedOut: Signed out. Your workspace is retained.
workerLimit: All editor slots are in use. Ask the host to stop an unused workspace or increase the limit.
workerFailed: The workspace could not start. Ask the host to check the service.
workspaceUpdated: The host changed your workspace folders. Reconnect to continue.
